source_law: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.
goal: Harden the LuHm OS pet shell from fullscreen Cathedral through compact player, pet inspection, chat-head/bubble, background companion, and explicit quit while keeping Ollama, Termux:X11, Android lifecycle, source-of-truth, licensing, and Crown boundaries fail-closed.

ux_modes.intent: Original Winamp-inspired compact floating control strip without copying Winamp artwork or skins.
ux_modes.implementation: Desktop/X11 borderless compact window; Android remains an in-app compact mode until native shell evidence exists.

ux_modes.intent: Cute adult pixel-anime wifey sitter inspection window with touch/gamepad controls.
ux_modes.implementation: Original LuHm assets only; provenance manifest required for any third-party donor asset.
Godot/X11 floating window on desktop; Android system bubble requires a native Android notification/conversation lane and explicit user enablement. No fake overlay claim.

ux_modes.intent: Keep local companion services available without leaving a visible game window.
ux_modes.implementation: Termux/Ollama/X11 companion processes remain separate from the Android runtime. Android persistent background work must obey current foreground-service/background-start rules and visible notification requirements where applicable.

ux_modes.intent: Explicitly stop LuHm-owned UI/processes and return control to the operator.
ux_modes.implementation: No hidden restart, no zombie child ownership, no kill-all behavior outside known LuHm process scope.

rules: feature-gate desktop window flags
do not claim Android always-on-top support from desktop APIs
no arbitrary shell execution
no embedded secrets
bind local-only unless explicitly Crown-approved otherwise
do not treat the unauthenticated local API as safe for network exposure
prefer OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD when a strictly local session is required
bound model keep-alive and concurrency for mobile thermals
probe actual daemon and model state before reporting GREEN

termux.role: operator-owned local toolchain and companion services
rules: no Termux execution bridge inside the LuHm Android runtime
no root requirement
scoped permissions only
runtime dependencies stay in Termux private home unless proven safe elsewhere

termux_x11.role: desktop/X11 host for real floating sitter windows
rules: use the official Termux:X11 app plus companion package as a matched pair
do not recommend SELinux disabling or root bypasses
keep display/process ownership explicit
quit must distinguish Android activity from X server process
system bubbles are user-controlled
conversation bubble requirements must be satisfied before claiming support
foreground-service start restrictions apply
persistent background execution is not equivalent to an immortal process

sprite_contract.style: original cute sexy pixel-anime adult wifey sitters, mature but non-explicit
sprite_contract.copyright: Original or license-audited assets only; community references do not become shipping permission.

ten_pass_audit.name: source-truth
ten_pass_audit.gate: Canonical repo and exact base commit recorded; legacy KAI/Hydra/Termux claims cannot silently override current LuHm OS source.

ten_pass_audit.name: process-lifecycle
ten_pass_audit.gate: Every visible/background/quit transition has an owner, an exit path, and no hidden respawn.

ten_pass_audit.name: android-lifecycle
ten_pass_audit.gate: Background execution, bubble behavior, and service starts are represented as native-shell work, not assumed Godot capability.

ten_pass_audit.name: ollama-locality
ten_pass_audit.gate: Ollama remains local companion by default; network exposure, cloud use, model residency, and concurrency are explicit knobs.

ten_pass_audit.name: termux-x11
ten_pass_audit.gate: X11 window sitter path is optional, non-root, and separate from clean Android runtime authority.

ten_pass_audit.name: window-capability
ten_pass_audit.gate: Borderless/always-on-top/transparency are feature-gated; Android and X11 capabilities are not conflated.

ten_pass_audit.name: asset-provenance
ten_pass_audit.gate: Pixel sitter assets require original authorship or explicit license/provenance before shipping.

ten_pass_audit.name: security
ten_pass_audit.gate: No secrets, arbitrary shell, remote admin, donor-code auto-execution, root bypass, or public control plane.

ten_pass_audit.name: ci-evidence
ten_pass_audit.gate: JSON validation plus deterministic audit must pass; Android/Godot build evidence remains a separate receipt.

ten_pass_audit.name: crown-reporting
ten_pass_audit.gate: Candidate may be sealed and saved, but main/release promotion remains a distinct Professor action after evidence review.
